- Tue, Jul 14: 09:30–10:30 or 14:00–15:00

- Architecture + deployment options (20m)
- Security/compliance walkthrough (15m)
- Q&A + next steps (20m)

If those slots don't work, share three alternatives and we'll do our best to accommodate. Also looping in Markus for visibility.

Thanks,

Apologies for the short notice — we just kicked off a SOC 2 evidence collection window this week and our security team has asked that any vendor demos which touch production or sensitive data be paused until the review completes. Procurement is also in a freeze while we finalize the SOW for Q3.

Can we hold off on the demo for now? Tentatively we can look at the week of Jul 27, but I need to confirm with security. If it's helpful, security@novahealth.com is on copy and can advise on what artifacts they'd like us to share ahead of a demo.

3) If approved, we'll send an invite for one of the sandbox slots and follow with procurement materials (SOW template + pricing).
